title: telemetry/v1
description: One telemetry sample an operator client sends for one of its bound aircraft (spec 02 F5, Art. 8(2)): the body of a WS /v1/telemetry frame ({"schema": "telemetry/v1", "body": ...}) and an item of POST /v1/telemetry/batch. ts is the client's own clock; the ingest places the sample on its clock (T-01, T-02). The positions are WGS84 decimal degrees, alt_wgs84_m is height above the WGS84 ellipsoid and alt_pressure_m the pressure altitude (ISA 1013.25 hPa, not AMSL); the ingest derives AMSL through the geoid. status, accuracy_h and accuracy_v are the F3411 v22a enumerations (RIDOperationalStatus, HorizontalAccuracy, VerticalAccuracy). seq increases by one per sample of a serial; epoch names the client's run of that counter and changes when the counter restarts. (serial, epoch, seq) with the same ts is a replay; the same key with another ts is a new sample (a restart that named no new epoch). backlog says the sample was queued before this delivery (T-04). end says the operator ends the flight with this sample. The trust class and the source are the ingest's, never the client's: a sample that carries either (trust simulated, source sitl, or any other) is refused (spec 06 T11).

ts.description: When the sample was taken, on the client's clock: RFC 3339 in UTC with Z.

serial.description: The aircraft's serial, bound to the client (06 T3).

epoch.description: The client's run of its seq counter, for example an id drawn at start: a new one whenever seq starts again.

intent_id.description: The activated intent this sample flies, when it flies one.

operator_position.description: The remote pilot's or the take-off position for this flight (Art. 8(2)(e)).
